O.content: The title literally reads "Declining Telehealth Follow-up Requests from 2012 to 2023".

B.text: If the chart title is an authoritative dashboard summary of the record's demand pattern, then its explicit characterization of the requests as declining supports decline-response follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies only if the literal title is intended to govern interpretation despite the plotted line's multi-year geometry.

O.content: The line segment from the point above 2022 to the endpoint above 2023 slopes downward on the page.
The printed x-axis year labels place 2022 immediately before 2023.
The printed y-axis labels show 0 near the bottom and 3000 near the top, and the axis is labeled "Telehealth follow-up requests".

B.text: If the x-axis years order the plotted line chronologically and higher vertical position encodes more telehealth follow-up requests, then a downward final segment indicates a recent decline; if routing is based on the latest year-to-year movement, select decline-response follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies only if the task treats the latest interval as decisive rather than the full-period pattern.

O.content: The line's 2023 endpoint is higher on the page than its 2012 endpoint.
The printed x-axis year labels run from 2012 at the left to 2023 at the right.
The printed y-axis labels show 0 near the bottom and 3000 near the top, and the axis is labeled "Telehealth follow-up requests".

B.text: If the x-axis years order the plotted line chronologically and the y-axis labels encode telehealth follow-up request magnitude increasing upward, then a substantially higher final plotted point than initial plotted point indicates overall growth across the displayed period; if the routing labels correspond to that overall pattern, select growth-response follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies when the task's 'overall request pattern' is assessed from the displayed period endpoints rather than only the latest interval.
